cards.say: **AI** is software that handles tasks we usually think need human judgment, like spotting a face in a photo, translating a sentence, or drafting an email.

cards.q: Which of these is a typical AI task?
options: Sorting photos by who appears in them
cards.why: Recognizing people in photos means finding patterns in messy data, which is where AI shines. The others follow fixed rules.

cards.q: Match each tool to what it does
pairs: Sorts email into junk and not junk
Predicts travel time from traffic patterns
Turns speech into text, then acts on it
Writes a reply to your message
cards.why: Each one learns patterns from data instead of following a hand-written rule for every case.

cards.q: Myth or fact: AI understands the world the way a person does.
cards.why: Today's AI finds patterns in data. It can be very useful without experiencing or understanding things the way a person does.

cards.after: from examples instead of relying only on hand-written rules.
cards.why: Learning patterns from lots of examples is the core idea behind machine learning.
